cell_type_or_model: Primary neurons, receptor-transfected cells and neuronal cultures/slices
assay_or_perturbation: Reelin receptor clustering; Src-family/Dab1 phosphorylation; Akt and neuronal migration/cytoskeletal assays
evidence_summary: Reelin binds/clusters LRP8/ApoER2 and activates a Dab1/Src/Akt relay associated with neuronal migration and cytoskeletal outputs.
limitations: Developmental comparator; receptor-specific and processed-fragment context must be preserved; no terminal TF was measured.
